extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

Specific immunoglobulin E (IgE) in-vitro allergy testing (CPT code 86003***, CPT code 86008****), up to 20 allergen specific antibodies per year, IS REIMBURSABLE for any of the following conditions:

In-vitro testing for total serum IgE (CPT code 82785*) IS REIMBURSABLE for any of the following conditions:

The antigen leukocyte antibody test (e.g., ALCAT) (CPT code 83516) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for the following conditions:

Adverse effect of other drugs, medicaments, and biological substances

In-vitro testing of allergen specific IgG or non-specific IgG, IgA, IgM, and IgD in the evaluation of suspected allergy (CPT code 82784, CPT code 82787, CPT code 86001**) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE. for the following conditions:

Adverse effect of other drugs, medicaments, and biological substances

Basophil activation flow cytometry testing (BAT) for measuring hypersensitivity to allergens (CPT code 88184*^, CPT code 88185*^) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

In-vitro allergen testing using bead-based epitope assays (e.g., VeriMAP Peanut Dx) (CPT code 0165U*^^, CPT code 0178U*^^) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

In-vitro testing of allergen non-specific IgE that does not identify a specific allergen using qualitative multi-allergen screen (CPT code 86005***) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.
